sections.theory:
Officials and their duties

Referee

The referee will inspect all the equipment.

He will be responsible for implementing the rules of the game from beginning to end.

He will start the game.

He will decide those matters on which the umpire and scorer do not agree.

Umpire

He is responsible for the ball being counted in play, the ball being dead, imposing penalties, ordering time-out, permitting substitute players, giving free throws, causing a jump ball, telling the scorer the number of the player on a foul, and deciding all other legal points.

Scorer

The scorer is responsible for keeping account of the points, recording the account of personal and technical fouls, informing the referee on the 5 fouls of a player, signalling time-out, and keeping the record of the names and numbers of every player and of substitute players.

Time keeper

Counting the time of the game and the time of the stopping of the game, running the time-out clock, informing at the end of every half or extra time by ringing the bell.
